english.title: Administer unauthorised veterinary medicinal product to an animal
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) administered a veterinary medicinal product, namely **(..SPECIFY PRODUCT..), to an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..), otherwise than in accordance with regulation 8 of the Veterinary Medicines Regulations 2013 in that **(..SPECIFY THE WAY IN WHICH THE ADMINISTRATION DID NOT COMPLY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 8, 43(d) and 44(1) of the Veterinary Medicines Regulations 2013.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
